MetLife is hiring an early-career Salesforce developer to build, test, configure, and support Salesforce-based capabilities for its GB360 Sales team. The role supports Sales Cloud workflows and integrations while collaborating with product, technical, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, maintainable solutions.
Finance
Property & Casualty Insurance
Health Insurance
Asset Management
Financial Services
Insurance
Life Insurance
Risk Management
No H1B
Responsibilities
Assist in building, testing, implementing, and supporting Salesforce-based GB360 Sales capabilities using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, declarative configuration, and platform APIs as appropriate
Support Sales Cloud and seller-productivity capabilities including opportunity workflows, pipeline processes, Book of Business views, activity capture, reporting, and sales-service handoffs
Apply configuration-first thinking to minimize unnecessary customization while supporting approved custom development when needed
Assist with user stories, estimates, technical notes, test inputs, release documentation, and support materials in partnership with product, functional, QA, and technical teammates
Support integrations connecting GB360 Sales with enterprise platforms such as Data Hubs, Seismic, underwriting, pricing, MetIQ, workflow systems, analytics, and related Sales Technology ecosystem components
Use approved AI-assisted development tools to support technical analysis, code generation, test design, documentation, defect analysis, and release preparation while applying human review and secure development practices
Participate in SAFe and Agile routines including PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, dependency discussions, defect triage, and production readiness reviews
Participate in peer reviews of Salesforce code, configuration, solution designs, test approaches, deployment plans, and release materials
Develop and execute unit tests, support automated testing where applicable, assist with system/integration testing and UAT, and help resolve defects before release
Assist with production support, incident investigation, performance tuning, Salesforce security or permission issues, integration failures, and technical debt remediation under guidance

Required
Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
1+ years of experience in software development, Salesforce development, application support, configuration, automation, or other technical delivery work
Internship, academic, project, or professional experience developing, testing, or supporting software, CRM, SaaS, or enterprise platform solutions
Exposure to Salesforce development or configuration concepts such as Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL/SOSL, data model, objects, fields, reports, dashboards, or Salesforce APIs
Understanding of Salesforce security model principles such as profiles, permission sets, sharing, roles, field-level security, authentication concepts, or data access controls
Working understanding of source control, deployment practices, automated testing, secure coding, issue tracking, release readiness, and production support concepts
Familiarity with Agile or SAFe delivery teams, including story refinement, estimation, sprint execution, testing support, demos, and release readiness
Interest in using approved AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, documentation, testing, and learning
Ability to learn Salesforce platform patterns, limits, integration concepts, and enterprise delivery standards quickly with guidance
Strong communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, problem solving, and attention to detail
(although applicants and employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States)
Preferred
Salesforce Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, Salesforce Administrator, or comparable Salesforce Trailhead/project experience
Exposure to Sales Cloud, opportunity management, pipeline workflows, Book of Business concepts, activity management, CRM Analytics, Salesforce Connect, or managed packages
Exposure to Salesforce Einstein-enabled capabilities, AI-assisted CRM workflows, recommendations, natural-language retrieval, or guided selling features
Familiarity with AutoRabit, Copado, Azure DevOps, Git, SFDX, Jenkins, Code Builder, or comparable Salesforce release and DevOps tooling
Experience with REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Bulk APIs, event-based patterns, data migration, ETL/ELT, middleware, or enterprise integration concepts
Experience with Seismic, Data Hub integrations, underwriting, pricing, MetIQ, workflow orchestration, analytics, or other enterprise data and content platforms
Experience in insurance, group benefits, broker/customer relationship management, commercial sales, sales operations, or enterprise CRM transformation
Exposure to accessibility, mobile Salesforce considerations, governor-limit awareness, performance troubleshooting, or production support standards

May also be eligible for annual short-term incentive compensation.
